Verses.VerseEn: The Most Compassionate (is He),
Who (Himself) taught the Qur’an to (the Arab Messenger [blessings and peace be upon him]).
He is the One Who created (this Absolutely Perfect) man.
He alone taught him the art of expression and communication (i.e. taught the True Messenger ma kana wa ma yakun)
The sun and the moon are rotating according to the configuration determined (by Him).
And the herbs spread over the earth and all (species of) the trees prostrate themselves (to Him alone).
And He is the One Who has maintained the sky raised high and (He is the One) Who has set up the balance (for justice),
So that you violate not the balance while weighing.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَقِيۡمُوۡا الۡوَزۡنَ بِالۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُوۡا الۡمِيۡزَانَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And keep weighing justly and do not make the balance fall short.
He is the One Who has spread out the earth for the creatures.
There are fruits in it and blossom-bearing date-palms,
And chaff-covered grain and fragrant (fruits) blooms.
So, (O assembly of jinn and men,) which of your Lord’s blessings will you deny?
He is the One Who created man from a dry mud sounding like earthenware,

Verses.VerseAr: وَخَلَقَ الۡجَآنَّ مِنۡ مَّارِجٍ مِّنۡ نَّارٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And created the jinn from a flame of fire.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
(He alone is) the Lord of both the easts and (He alone is) the Lord of both the wests.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
He is the One Who has made the two seas flow that join each other;
There is a barrier between them; they cannot breach (their respective) limits.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
The pearls (shading green) and corals (shading red) come forth from both (the seas).
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَهُ الۡجَوَارِ الۡمُنۡشَئٰتُ فِىۡ الۡبَحۡرِ كَالۡاَعۡلَامِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Under) His (control) are (also) the big vessels with lofty sails raised high (anchoring or sailing) in the sea like mountains.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
Whoever is on the earth will perish.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّيَبۡقٰى وَجۡهُ رَبِّكَ ذُوۡ الۡجَلٰلِ وَالۡاِكۡرَامِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Essence of your Lord, Who is the Master of Glory and Splendour and the Master of Bounty and Honour will remain.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: يَسۡـَٔـلُهٗ مَنۡ فِىۡ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِىۡ شَاۡنٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: All that are in the heavens and the earth beg from Him alone. Every moment His Glory manifests anew.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
O both the groups (of men and jinn,) soon shall We attend to your account.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: يٰمَعۡشَرَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ اِنِ اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ اَنۡ تَنۡفُذُوۡا مِنۡ اَقۡطَارِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ فَانفُذُوۡا‌ؕ لَا تَنۡفُذُوۡنَ اِلَّا بِسُلۡطٰنٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: O company of the jinn and men! If you have the power to go across the boundaries of the heaven and the earth (and overpower the universe), then go ahead. Whichever station (heavenly sphere) you will go to, there too will be His Kingdom alone.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: يُرۡسَلُ عَلَيۡكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّنۡ نَّارٍ ۙ وَّنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنۡتَصِرٰنِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The flames of pure (i.e. smokeless) fire will be sent upon both of you and (flameless) smoke (too will be sent) and you both will be unable to escape from them.

Words.MeaningEn: you will (be able to) defend yourselves

Verses.VerseEn: So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: فَاِذَا انْشَقَّتِ السَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ وَرۡدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when heavens will split apart and will become rosy like burnt oil (or red leather),
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: فَيَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لَّا يُسۡـَٔـلُ عَنۡ ذَنۡۢبِهٖۤ اِنۡسٌ وَّلَا جَآنٌّ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That Day no man or jinn will be asked about his sin.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: يُعۡرَفُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ بِسِيۡمٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِىۡ وَالۡاَقۡدَامِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The evildoers will be recognized by the darkness of their faces and so they will be pulled, seized by their forelocks and feet.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِىۡ يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ‌ۘ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘It is this Hell which the evildoers used to deny.’
They will move about in that (Hell) and in the boiling hot water.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
And whoever fears standing before his Lord (for Meeting), for him are two Gardens.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
They are (green and fresh Gardens) with deep thick branches.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
Two springs are flowing in both of them.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
In them are two kinds of every fruit.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: مُتَّكِــِٕيۡنَ عَلٰى فُرُشٍۢ بَطَآٮِٕنُهَا مِنۡ اِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ‌ؕ وَجَنَا الۡجَـنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The residents of Paradise will be reclining on couches lined with fine and thick brocade (i.e. satin) and the fruits of both the Gardens will be hanging low (over them).
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: فِيۡهِنَّ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرۡفِۙ لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ اِنۡسٌ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنٌّ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in them will be (chaste maidens) with downcast looks, untouched either by any man or by any jinn.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
As if they (chaste maidens) were rubies and pearls.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
The reward of good cannot be anything but good.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
And apart from these two there are also two more gardens (for them).
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
Both appear deep green tinting black.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
There are two springs which will be gushing with force in these two (as well).
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
In them also there are fruits, date-palms and pomegranates.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
In them are pious and beautiful (chaste maidens as well).
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?
The maidens who are veiling, confined in tents.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: لَمۡ يَطۡمِثۡهُنَّ اِنۡسٌ قَبۡلَهُمۡ وَلَا جَآنٌّ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Untouched before either by any man or jinn.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: مُتَّكِــِٕيۡنَ عَلٰى رَفۡرَفٍ خُضۡرٍ وَّعَبۡقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The residents of Paradise) will be (sitting) reclining on cushions over green carpets and rare and exquisite fine rugs.
So which of your Lord’s blessings will you both deny?

Verses.VerseAr: تَبٰرَكَ اسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِىۡ الۡجَـلٰلِ وَالۡاِكۡرَامِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Most Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Master of Glory and Splendour and the Master of Bounty and Honour.
